Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0172-reverse-01", "row_sha256": "eef0fe54c15c3c2d2f9a9c50165a68a5aeb95d90511017a4f961f0082026e8b9", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we started the screen reader audit at the east branch service desk on tuesday morning and tested the self checkout station with the standard keyboard settings the first pass covered the welcome screen the language menu and the instructions for scanning a library card the reader announced each heading but it skipped the short note beside the volume control i wrote down the station number as kiosk 4 and repeated the test after closing and reopening the page the second pass read the note correctly but it announced the help button before the instructions which made the order confusing

the service ticket also lists the replacement speaker at $46.71 but that is not the amount charged the actual cost was $161.98 not $46.71 the receipt shows the higher amount and the library card ending in 0826 was used for the purchase i checked the receipt against the purchasing log before adding the correction to my audit notes please keep both amounts in the report and mark $46.71 as the incorrect ticket figure the audit is still in progress because we have not tested the station with headphones yet", "output": "We started the screen reader audit at the east branch service desk on Tuesday morning and tested the self checkout station with the standard keyboard settings. The first pass covered the welcome screen, the language menu, and the instructions for scanning a library card. The reader announced each heading, but it skipped the short note beside the volume control. I wrote down the station number as kiosk 4 and repeated the test after closing and reopening the page. The second pass read the note correctly, but it announced the help button before the instructions, which made the order confusing.

The service ticket also lists the replacement speaker at $46.71, but that is not the amount charged. The actual cost was $161.98, not $46.71. The receipt shows the higher amount, and the library card ending in 0826 was used for the purchase. I checked the receipt against the purchasing log before adding the correction to my audit notes. Please keep both amounts in the report and mark $46.71 as the incorrect ticket figure. The audit is still in progress because we have not tested the station with headphones yet."}]
